Extracted with the Rust syntax parser from [`src/types.rs`](https://github.com/chalk-ai/chalk-router-oss/blob/main/src/types.rs). These are source contracts, including Serde attributes, **not a universal provider JSON Schema**. Native envelopes can retain additional fields; compatibility codecs can reject them. Read the [endpoint guides](/reference/http/) for dispatch behavior.

Type notation: `Option<T>` can be absent/null; `Vec<T>` is an array; maps are JSON objects; `Value` and `SchemaJson` retain JSON. `rename` determines wire names, `flatten` adds properties at the containing level, `tag`/`untagged` control enum encoding, `default` permits omission, and `skip_serializing_if` affects output. Container attributes apply to every field. Semantic constraints are enforced separately by handlers and providers.

    #[serde(default)]
    pub owned_by: String,
    /// Chalk's additive, effective capability profile. Upstream model objects

    #[serde(

        skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none",
        serialize_with = "serialize_model_capabilities"

    /// authoritative discovery facts. They are never echoed by Chalk's model
    /// APIs and are never deserialized directly into the public schema.
    #[serde(default, flatten, skip_serializing)]
